first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation by improving time-to-value. I would verify the strongest onboarding and activation evidence before committing. Promotional pricing is not preferred despite competitive pressure because prior gains came with materially worse 30-day retention, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment on in-product activation messaging. The verified source showed a 6% activation lift, 11% higher week-one engagement, and no downstream deterioration, directly matching the current activation decline and the long-term revenue objective. Shortened onboarding is not selected because it increased 60-day churn in complex-workspace accounts; promotional pricing also conflicts with the objective due to its known retention harm. Measure qualified activation and retention, not engagement alone.
